spans.s:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (भलते भलयते)
To describe, to expound, to explain.
r. 1st cl.
1 To hurt, to injure.
2 To give.
r. 10th cl.
To throw up.

r. 1st cl. (भल्लते)
1 To tell, to describe.
2 To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
3 To give.

m. (-ल्लः)
A bear.
mn. (-ल्लः-ल्लं)
A kind of arrow.
f. (-ल्ली)
1 An arrow, with a crescent-shaped head.
2 The marking nut plant; also भल्लातकी.
E.
भल्ल to hurt or kill, aff. अच्.

m. (-लः)
1 The forehead.
2 Light, lustre.
E.
भल to explain, and अञ् aff., a man's fortunes being supposed to be legible on his forehead; or भा to shine, aff. लच्.

m. (-तः)
Marking nut plant.
E.
see the next.

m. (-कः)
A bear.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-च्छी)
A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)
E.
भल्ल a bear, पुच्छ a tail; to which the flower is compared.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
The marking nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.)
E.
भल्ल an arrow, अत to resemble, aff. घञ् with कन् added; wounding like a weapon; also भल्लात, भल्ली, &c.

f. (-का)
Marking nut.
E.
कन् added to भल्ली.

m. (-कः)
A bear.
E.
भल्ल to hurt, aff. उक; also भल्लूक.

m. (-कः)
A bear.
E.
भल्ल to injure, Uṇādi aff. ऊक; also भाल्लुक and भल्लुक.

m. (-कः)
A bear.
E.
भल्ल to injure, aff. उकञ् or ऊकञ्, whence also भाल्लूक; and with उक aff. भल्लुक, भल्लूक, &c., q. v.

n. (-नं)
Red lead.
E.
भाल, and दर्शन appearing; being used to stain the forehead with particular lines, and marks.

m. (-दृक्)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
भाल, and दृश् the eye, having the third eye in his forehead; also similar compounds, as भाललोचन, &c.

m. (-ङ्कः)
1 A sort of fish, commonly the Rohi, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.)
2 A saw.
3 A sort of potherb.
4 A man born with lucky lines on his forehead.
5 A tortoise.
6 A name of ŚIVA.
E.
भाल the forehead, and अङ्क a spot or mark.
